items.heading: Nasi Lemak
details: Key ingredients: coconut rice, sambal, anchovies, peanuts, egg
Cook rice in coconut milk with pandan leaf until fragrant.
Fry small anchovies and peanuts until crisp.
Prepare a spicy sambal sauce.
Plate the coconut rice with the sambal, anchovies, peanuts and a boiled or fried egg.

items.heading: Rendang
details: Key ingredients: beef, coconut milk, lemongrass, chili, galangal
Blend chili, lemongrass, galangal and shallots into a fragrant paste.
Fry the paste until dark and aromatic.
Add beef and coconut milk, simmering slowly.
Cook uncovered, stirring often, until the sauce reduces to a thick, dark coating.

items.heading: Laksa
details: Ingredients: main ingredient, onion/garlic or other aromatics, oil or fat, salt, spices/herbs and water/stock as needed.
Prepare and cut the main ingredients.
Sauté or toast the aromatics and spices, add the main ingredients and cook using the traditional simmering, steaming, baking or grilling method until done.
